title: Hearty Spanish Bread Toast
description: Buttery, crumbly toast with oyster sauce that satisfies midnight cravings in a FODMAP-friendly way.
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and add olive oil.
Place bread slices in the skillet and toast until golden brown on both sides, about 2 minutes per side.
While the bread is toasting, melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat until foamy.
Brush the melted butter over each slice of toast, coating both sides evenly.
Remove the toast and spread a thin layer of oyster sauce on each slice.
Place the toasted slices back in the skillet, sauce side down, and cook for 1 minute to meld flavors.
Transfer the toast to a plate, top each with a light scramble of eggs.
Sprinkle grated Manchego cheese over the eggs if using, allowing it to melt slightly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately for a warm, satisfying midnight snack.
